data.short_description: Peak Sim Racing is bringing 12 high-tech racing simulators to a 3,200-square-foot space on South Broadway in Denver. The simulators are divided into premium, standard, and esports tiers, with eight featuring full-motion platforms.

data.location: 701 Barataria Blvd, Suite C, Marrero, LA 70072
data.status: currently building out a new location
data.short_description: Kay Rhythm Dance Studio is moving to a new location on the Westbank in Marrero, just around the corner from its current spot, ahead of the 2027 parade season. The studio, led by owner-director Ka'Lyn Gilbert-Wilson, uses an all-adult teaching staff focused on technique and fundamentals.

data.location: 119 N Main St, Church Point, LA 70525
data.status: preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar location
data.short_description: The Sai Edit Boutique, previously an online and pop-up business, is opening its first physical storefront in Church Point. The store will feature curated clothing from independent vendors, including Texas-based Lulu Mac, plus a space for local vendors selling baby clothing, home décor, and gifts.

data.status: venue is expected to open this fall
data.short_description: SportX is bringing 20 pickleball courts, 20 cornhole lanes, GellyBall, and a GameDay hangout spot to Mooresville near Mazeppa Park. The venue will also offer a clubhouse, green space, and guest food trucks for tournaments, corporate events, and parties.

Philadelphia Golf Club, a private members-only club operated by Julian Colina, is debuting inside The Packard Grande in Rittenhouse. The 3,200-square-foot mezzanine space will include a lounge, private elevator entrance, lockers, three TrackMan simulator bays, and a PuttView putting area, capped at 100 members.

data.status: exact opening date remains in development
data.short_description: Tacos Tijuana, a street-taco concept started from a food truck in 2016, is opening its newest Valley location at Barnone at Agritopia this October. The family plans to celebrate opening day with live mariachi music and additional promotions.

data.location: 887 N Milwaukee Ave, Unit 400, Vernon Hills, IL 60061
data.short_description: Postino is opening its first Midwest location at Mellody Farm in Vernon Hills, featuring a 3,708-square-foot interior and 900-square-foot patio. The restaurant will include a seasonal enclosed patio, custom walnut wine walls, and signature Postino décor elements.
